rationale: The pain is real and documented across IT admin forums, but evidence of willingness to pay for a dedicated tool is absent. Free alternatives (Microsoft documentation, community scripts, PowerShell galleries) adequately serve the need, and the low signal strength (2) combined with low defensibility (3) and a single source thread cannot meet the 5-distinct-pain-quotes threshold. MSPs solve this once per client setup rather than as a recurring workflow, undermining the subscription value proposition.
